geometry.samplePolicy: One frozen source-space native ink sample at each module center; no reader output is consulted. Measurement method, threshold and actual raster hashes must be recorded by empirical owner.
geometry.status: example schema only; no measurements or source supplied here

groups.state0: Arial regular, black, native visible text
groups.state1: Arial bold, black, native visible text

inputRequirements: This illustrative file is deliberately incomplete and is rejected as solver input.
Use all n*n coordinates exactly once for complete=true. Partial input must say complete=false and cannot establish complete sample feasibility.
base is measured state0 ink at the sample. toggle means measured state1 differs from state0 at that same sample.
Tie every variable to one real source character, or a declared larger whole-text unit. Never invent independent pixel controls.
A sample influenced by more than one independently styled glyph is unsupported by this affine schema; reject overlap or supply a correct separate nonlinear model.
Native finder ink is included in all samples, including ink outside nominal seven-module boxes. No clipping or assumed envelope.
No white, transparent, hidden, duplicated or faint-text state. Both styles must retain visible readable native source text.
Changing the font/weight may change advance or ink placement; freeze exact full-source positions and measure both states, with actual complete source hashes.
